body:
New LevelCharacter parser + server_apply_custom_level wiring, gated strictly to MODE_STORY/MODE_STORY_CAVE with a real safety analysis (confirmed the MODE_QUEUE call site can never trigger it). Live-verified end to end: a hand-written test level with 2 authored characters correctly reset the VOXWORLD encounter and spawned exactly those 2 roles at their authored positions, both genuinely ticking and moving. Closes the loop S466 (server AI) + S467 (distinct rendering) opened. make server/lobby clean. Commit ba8774b + 4aabee2 + bfdd2e2.

⚓ ☃
